caption: The drawing depicts a metal mug with a cylindrical body and a curved handle attached to one side. The mug is predominantly red, with areas where the paint is chipped or worn, revealing a metallic or gray base underneath. Decorative elements include yellow and gold designs: a scalloped yellow line encircles the upper part of the mug below the rim, and a pattern of yellow leaves runs just above the bottom edge. Near the rim, a black band encircles the mug, featuring a wavy cream and brown pattern and small black dots. The handle is painted red with visible wear and rust patches. The interior of the mug is gray with areas that appear to be corroded or stained. The drawing is centered on a plain, cream-colored background, and there is a small artist's signature, "C. H. Ewing," in the lower left corner.
title: Measure Cup
